modules.title: Project Dashboard
modules.limits: Not built. Today there is one draft in the browser (localStorage) and a template picker; no project list, no status cards.

modules.title: Game Designer
modules.limits: The canonical v4 spec editors. Field ownership locks for derived modules are not built; with derivation off every field is owned by the Designer.

modules.title: Asset Studio
modules.limits: Import, library, provenance, preview and delete protection only. Assigning an asset to a kind, sprite sheets and animation are later tasks. Assets will not render or play in the native apps (no v4 asset concept; E1 is conditional).

modules.title: Sprite and Animation Editor
modules.limits: Not built. The animations manifest schema exists. Native rendering needs engine track E1, which is conditional and not started.

modules.title: Level Studio
modules.limits: Only the active level compiles into the native spec; other levels are Studio-only variants exported as standalone specs. No wave end, per-level win rule or in-app level selection (see multi-level-in-app).

modules.title: Gameplay Systems
modules.limits: Not built as a module. Lives, win score and collisions can be edited today under Game Designer. Health, power-ups and progression need contract changes and stay planned.

modules.title: Backend and Services
modules.limits: Not built. Will generate scaffold text and mock stubs only. Never a live Firebase connection.

modules.title: Monetization
modules.limits: Not built. Will support mock and official Google test configurations only. No production ad ids in Studio.

modules.title: Kiro Development
modules.limits: Only the static Developer Integration inventory exists. Pack export, ownership manifest, drift check and proposal inbox are not built. There is no Kiro connection.

modules.title: Preview and Device Lab
modules.limits: Browser preview, determinism badge and hash-bound native evidence exist. The environments table is not built. Studio runs no device; it shows committed evidence only.

modules.title: Build and Release
modules.limits: Only the native source ZIP export exists. Completeness check and release readiness are not built. No signing, upload or store-ready claim.

capabilities.title: Project list, status cards and bundle in and out
capabilities.limits: Not built. One draft and a template picker exist today.
capabilities.requires: Project context and persistence (task 1.2), dashboard UI (task 1.3).

capabilities.title: Project Brain editors for the v4 spec with engine validation
capabilities.limits: Edits the canonical spec directly. Forms follow spec/schema.

capabilities.title: Canonical spec view, import and export through the engine serializer
capabilities.limits: One draft only; refused files leave the draft unchanged.

capabilities.title: Read-only fields owned by a derived module
capabilities.limits: Not built.
capabilities.requires: Derivation (levels, gameplay) and the cross-reference index.

capabilities.title: Lives, win score, collectibles and enemies compiled into lives, winScore and collisions
capabilities.limits: Not built. Opt-in derivation, default off; the derived diff and engine verdict are shown before the spec changes.
capabilities.requires: Gameplay compiler (task 5.1), apply path (task 4.2).
capabilities.designRow: Lives, win score, collectible and enemy collision rows

capabilities.title: Difficulty ramp as later-starting spawners
capabilities.limits: Not built. v4 spawners cannot stop or change; a ramp is an extra spawner that starts later.
capabilities.requires: Level compiler (task 4.1).

capabilities.title: Health, power-ups, progression
capabilities.limits: Designed only. Not buildable on the v4 contract.
capabilities.requires: A timed-state and persistence contract in the engine, which is outside this milestone.

capabilities.title: Active level compiled into initial entities and spawners
capabilities.limits: Active level only. Applied through an explicit action that the engine and a bounded oracle run must accept; one undo step.
capabilities.designRow: Initial placements, spawners, difficulty ramp (as later-starting spawners)

capabilities.title: Other levels exported as standalone spec variants
capabilities.limits: Variants are not selectable inside the generated app. The ZIP holds only studio-pack/derived/levels/<id>/monstera.spec.json; the full Studio pack is a later task.

capabilities.title: Level selection, per-level win rule and wave end inside the native app
capabilities.limits: Schema v4 has one runtime and spawners that never stop. Engine track E3, outside hackathon scope.
capabilities.requires: Engine and schema change after G6 closure.

capabilities.title: Import, library and provenance of images and audio
capabilities.limits: Studio-only: the native apps do not render or play assets. Origin and license are user declarations; only the license shape is checked. MP3 trailing data cannot be detected by content checks; OGG and MP3 need a browser that can read their metadata.

capabilities.title: Assets rendered or played inside the generated apps
capabilities.limits: Conditional on engine track E1 (gate 2026-11-19); not started.
capabilities.requires: Engine track E1 and the G6 closure.

capabilities.title: Atlas slicing, frames and animation sequences with a tick-based preview
capabilities.limits: Not built. Studio preview and export only.
capabilities.requires: Slicing and timeline library (task 3.1) and editors (tasks 3.2 and 3.3).

capabilities.title: Sprite sheets and animations rendered inside the generated apps
capabilities.limits: Conditional on engine track E1 (one atlas, one or two sequences, both platforms); not started.
capabilities.requires: Engine track E1 and the G6 closure.

capabilities.title: Firebase and AdMob scaffold text and setup instructions
capabilities.limits: Not built. Scaffold text is exported, not compiled into the app. Not a live backend.
capabilities.requires: Integrations manifest and emitters (tasks 6.1 and 6.2).
capabilities.designRow: Firebase interfaces and stubs, AdMob placements and mock rewarded ad

capabilities.title: Live Firebase connection, account or resource creation from Studio
capabilities.limits: Studio is static: no backend, no credentials, no network call to third parties.
capabilities.requires: A server and a credential model, which are not part of Studio.

capabilities.title: Placement configuration, frequency rules and a labelled mock rewarded ad
capabilities.limits: Not built. Mock and official test configurations only. Not compiled into the app unless engine track E2 is approved.
capabilities.requires: Integrations manifest and emitters (tasks 6.1 to 6.3).

capabilities.title: Production AdMob ids in Studio
capabilities.limits: Decision D7: Studio never stores or emits real ad ids; the developer adds them after export, in developer-owned files.
capabilities.requires: Not planned.

capabilities.title: Static inventory of agents, hooks, steering and MCP tools, plus handoff prompts
capabilities.limits: A static inventory stamped with the commit. It does not connect to Kiro.

capabilities.title: Studio pack export with ownership manifest and drift-check script
capabilities.limits: Not built. Extension roots are written once and are not compiled into the app.
capabilities.requires: Pack layout and exporter (tasks 7.1 and 7.2).

capabilities.title: Review and apply an externally produced proposal
capabilities.limits: Not built. Proposals are data, validated and applied only on user acceptance.
capabilities.requires: Proposal schema (done), apply path (task 4.2) and UI (task 7.4).

capabilities.title: Direct AI provider calls from the browser
capabilities.limits: Decision D6: no provider calls and no keys in the browser during this milestone.
capabilities.requires: A server that holds keys; not part of Studio.

capabilities.title: Secure replaceable AI provider architecture
capabilities.limits: Roadmap only. Interface sketched in design section 8.3; no implementation.
capabilities.requires: A server that holds keys and a provider interface.

capabilities.title: Interactive preview driven by the unmodified engine
capabilities.limits: Browser environment. The preview drawing code mirrors the presentation modules for display only.

capabilities.title: Oracle against the recorded golden scenarios for the exact spec
capabilities.limits: Oracle environment inside the browser worker; says nothing about devices.

capabilities.title: Committed native build and simulator evidence bound to the exact spec SHA-256
capabilities.limits: Shows committed evidence only; an edited spec shows no evidence.

capabilities.title: Table of checks by environment (browser, oracle, jvm, swift-test, simulator, device)
capabilities.limits: Not built.
capabilities.requires: Evidence indexes already built into Studio (task 8.0).

capabilities.title: Running tests on emulators, simulators or physical devices from Studio
capabilities.limits: Studio is static and runs no device. Device Lab (G5) scripts produce evidence outside Studio.
capabilities.requires: Not planned in Studio.

capabilities.title: Native source ZIP generated by the engine in the browser
capabilities.limits: Source only. Nothing is compiled by Studio.

capabilities.title: Completeness check and release-readiness checklist
capabilities.limits: Not built. It will never claim store readiness.
capabilities.requires: Tasks 8.1 and the cross-reference index (task 1.4).

capabilities.title: Signing, store upload or a store-ready claim
capabilities.limits: Out of scope: no signing, no upload, no store-ready claim without evidence.
capabilities.requires: Not planned.

capabilities.title: Project identity, module list and derivation switches (project manifest)
capabilities.limits: Schema and validation only; no UI or storage uses it yet.
capabilities.designRow: Project identity, module list, derivation switches

capabilities.title: Versioned sidecar manifest schemas with strict TypeScript validation
capabilities.limits: Validates Studio-owned manifests only. The engine validates the spec. Cross-manifest references are task 1.4.

capabilities.title: Bundle, source-map and source scan for credential-shaped strings
capabilities.limits: Pattern based; findings never print values.

capabilities.title: nosniff and a Content-Security-Policy, report-only first
capabilities.limits: Verified on a local preview of the built site only. Not deployed: the live site sends neither header until the Vercel Root Directory is confirmed and a report-only deployment is reviewed.
